projectOps.tool.title: Call a project operation
projectOps.checkTool.title: Check the operations API list
projectOps.timeline.failed: The assistant's call to {op} on project "{project}" didn't work ({result})
projectOps.timeline.detail.sayFilled: What to say (not given by the operation, filled in by Ergo): {say}
projectOps.check.waiting: {count} operations are well-formed and the tests that can run pass; {waiting} on the project's service will be tested once it's up after you confirm
projectOps.check.passed: Checked: all {count} operations' tests pass and the read-only ones write nothing
projectOps.problem.topNotObject: The top level must be an object ({ "endpoint": …, "tools": [...] })
projectOps.problem.endpointNotObject: endpoint must be an object: { "service": "<service name>", "path": "/ops" }
projectOps.problem.endpointService: endpoint.service must be the name of a service in the operations plan (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens)
projectOps.problem.endpointPath: endpoint.path must start with / (the path the service itself receives, e.g. /ops), not with //, and have no spaces
projectOps.problem.noTools: There is no tools array (operations go under tools, in the MCP tools/list format)
projectOps.problem.opNotObject: Operation {which} must be an object (name, title, description…)
projectOps.problem.opBadName: Operation {which}'s name "{name}" may only use letters, digits, _ . - (up to 128)
projectOps.problem.opReserved: Operation {name} has the same name as a built-in operation (every project has those; don't list them)
projectOps.problem.titleNotString: Operation {name}'s title must be a sentence
projectOps.problem.userSaysNotStrings: Operation {name}'s userSays must be a list of sentences
projectOps.problem.inputSchemaNotObject: Operation {name}'s inputSchema must be an object (JSON Schema: { "type": "object", "properties": {…} })
projectOps.problem.inputSchemaType: Operation {name}'s inputSchema.type must be "object" (arguments are an object)
projectOps.problem.annotationsNotObject: Operation {name}'s annotations must be an object
projectOps.problem.readOnlyHintNotBool: Operation {name}'s annotations.readOnlyHint must be true or false
projectOps.problem.kindInvalid: Operation {name}'s kind "{value}" must be query (read-only), action (has side effects) or run (starts a run)
projectOps.problem.kindConflict: Operation {name}'s kind doesn't match annotations.readOnlyHint (query goes with true, action and run with false)
projectOps.problem.riskInvalid: Operation {name}'s risk "{value}" must be direct, confirm or handoff
projectOps.problem.implNotObject: Operation {name}'s impl must be an object: { "type": "http" | "script" | "ergo" | "maintainer", … }
projectOps.problem.implTypeInvalid: Operation {name}'s impl.type "{value}" must be http, script, ergo or maintainer
projectOps.problem.scriptFile: Operation {name}'s impl.file must be a script's path relative to the working directory (not absolute, no ..)
projectOps.problem.scriptExt: Operation {name}'s script {file} is of an unknown type (known extensions: {exts})
projectOps.problem.scriptArgs: Operation {name}'s impl.args must be a list of strings
projectOps.problem.ergoAction: Operation {name}'s impl.action "{action}" isn't one of Ergo's own actions ({actions})
projectOps.problem.ergoParams: Operation {name}'s impl.params must be an object
projectOps.problem.testNotObject: Operation {name}'s test must be an object: { "args": {…}, "sayIncludes"?: "…" }
projectOps.problem.testArgsNotObject: Operation {name}'s test.args must be an object
projectOps.problem.testSayIncludes: Operation {name}'s test.sayIncludes must be non-empty text
projectOps.problem.missingDescription: Operation {name} doesn't say when to use it (description)
projectOps.problem.missingUserSays: Operation {name} doesn't list how the user might ask for it (userSays)
projectOps.problem.missingKind: Operation {name} has no kind (query, action or run)
projectOps.problem.schemaUnusable: Operation {name}'s arguments (JSON Schema) can't be used: {reason}
projectOps.problem.schemaPropNotObject: Operation {name}'s argument {prop} must be an object (JSON Schema)
projectOps.problem.schemaRequiredUnknown: Operation {name} lists {prop} under required, but it isn't in properties
projectOps.problem.schemaEnumNames: Operation {name}'s argument {prop} is an enum; give every value a name (enumNames, or a title on each oneOf item)
projectOps.problem.schemaEnumNamesLength: Operation {name}'s argument {prop} has a different number of enumNames than enum values
projectOps.problem.schemaDefaultInvalid: Operation {name}'s argument {prop} has a default that doesn't fit its own schema: {reason}
projectOps.problem.testArgsInvalid: Operation {name}'s test arguments don't fit its arguments: {reason}
projectOps.problem.placeholderUnknown: Operation {name} refers to argument {placeholder}, which it doesn't have
projectOps.problem.scriptMissing: Operation {name}'s script {file} isn't in the project's working directory
projectOps.problem.endpointUnknownServic: The list puts the call port on service "{service}", but this project has no such service (its services: {names}). Have its maintainer fix endpoint.service in ops.json.
projectOps.problem.endpointAmbiguous: This project has several services ({names}); endpoint.service in the list must say which one has the call port. Have its maintainer add it.
projectOps.problem.endpointNoService: This project has no service on LSM (no "service" item in the operations plan, or it was taken down), so the call port has nowhere to go.
projectOps.problem.maintainerUnavailable: Operation {name} hands the job to the maintainer, but this project can't take it now: {reason}
projectOps.problem.testNoSay: Operation {name}'s test reply has no say to read out (reply { "say": "…", "detail": … }, or structuredContent.say in a CallToolResult)
projectOps.problem.testWaiting: Operation {name} can only be tested while the service is running: {reason}
projectOps.problem.warnManyParams: Operation {name} has {count} arguments; that's hard to say by voice (keep them few and simple)
projectOps.problem.warnNested: Operation {name}'s argument {prop} is a nested object; that's hard to say by voice
projectOps.problem.warnNoDefault: Operation {name}'s optional argument {prop} has no default
